title: Short CPU spike that resolves on its own
symptoms: CPU usage above 90% on a web server for about a minute, then resolved itself in 60 seconds. A single HighCPU alert that clears quickly, with no errors in the application logs.
root_cause: A short-lived job (cron task, cache warm-up, deploy, GC) briefly uses all CPU. The server recovers by itself.
impact: Usually none. A few requests may be slightly slower during the spike.
fix_steps: No immediate action needed if it resolved in under 2 minutes.
Check cron and deploy history around the spike time to find the trigger.
If it repeats, add a 'for: 5m' clause to the alert rule.
prevention: Schedule heavy jobs off-peak and only alert on sustained CPU, not single samples.
